description: Analog partition layout: the two checks that back layout/osc_bank.gds beyond klt's own stream checks -- byte-identical regeneration from layout/gen/gen_osc_bank.py, and the net-connectivity sanity check (not LVS; that is issue #26).

checks.name: regenerate-byte-identical
argv: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; python3 layout/gen/gen_osc_bank.py -o "$d/osc_bank.gds" >/dev/null; cmp "$d/osc_bank.gds" layout/osc_bank.gds
